name: XCP-ng / XenServer / Xen Orchestra
author: Netlens
description: Reads the pools of Vates VMS (XCP-ng with Xen Orchestra) and of XenServer: hosts, virtual machines with their addresses and the storage repositories. Talks to a Xen Orchestra, or straight to a pool master when there is none. Read-only, unless you let auto-remediation restart a VM.

config.label: Xen Orchestra or pool master
config.help: The address of a Xen Orchestra (it manages every pool it knows, one line is enough), or of the pool master of an XCP-ng / XenServer pool when you have no Xen Orchestra. Netlens finds out which one it is. HTTPS is assumed when you leave the scheme out.

columns.label: Certificate fingerprint
columns.help: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's certificate. When filled in, exactly that certificate is trusted (also a self-signed one).

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Turn off for the self-signed certificate XCP-ng and Xen Orchestra use by default. Better: fill in the certificate fingerprint.

config.label: Allow plain http
config.help: Off: an address that starts with http:// is refused, because the password or token would cross the network unencrypted. Turn on only for a lab.

dashboard.title: Xen virtual machines
dashboard.about: Virtual machines on your XCP-ng / XenServer hosts: running, stopped and how many in all.
